text:
Priya (Account Exec): Quick heads-up — Nova Health (Ent) signed last week. During onboarding their SSO + embeddings integration is failing validation. Sales flagged potential renewal concern if CTA not met by next Mon. Sharing context + logs below. @Kendall please own CS side, @Samir can you triage ML perf?

Samir (ML Eng): Got it. What's failing exactly?

Priya (Account Exec): Embedding mismatch — their vectors look garbage after deploy. They pasted sample in ticket. Also streaming responses are timing out intermittently.

Kendall (CS): I'll coordinate kickoff with customer tomorrow 10am PT. Can you dump the ticket + sample?

Priya (Account Exec): Ticket #NH-457 in Zendesk. Pasted sample here:
```
text: "patient followup q: schedule MRI"
embedding: [0.001, -0.23, ... , 0.004]
service error: "kv_cache miss -> fallback to cpu-quant path"
latency: 1200ms (target < 400ms)
```

Samir (ML Eng): Hmm kv_cache miss + quant fallback could explain quality + latency. Which model/quant profile are you using?

Priya (Account Exec): Using "rw_large_v2-8q" on Dedicated. Provisioned pool on west-us. Customer using short contexts (<=128 tokens).

Samir (ML Eng): I'm going to run a repro on a staging replica. If quant path is the issue we can force higher-precision for this customer or adjust kernel selection. Will report back in 90m.

Jules (Support Eng): FYI I saw their trace — the pool has intermittent OOMs when concurrent batch > 8. Might be autoscaler config + batch size mismatch. I'll add a temporary limit.

Kendall (CS): Thanks. Action items:
- Kendall: Kickoff w/ customer, collect repro prompt + recent request IDs (tomorrow 10am PT)
- Samir: Repro + perf dive, suggest config (90m)
- Jules: Apply temporary batch cap on Dedicated pool and monitor (in 30m)
- Priya: Update exec contact and set expectation for Monday follow-up

Priya (Account Exec): +1. Also capture feedback on docs for SSO + embeddings for new onboarding flow.

Samir (ML Eng): If we need quick rollback, we can pin them to rw_large_v2-16q (higher precision) for 24h. I'll include token cost delta.

deploy-bot: Deployment change applied: batch_cap=8 on pool-nova-west at 3501235600 :white_check_mark:

Kendall (CS): Great. I'll post notes from the kickoff here. Please ping if you need access to their logs (#NH-457).
